claim.property: No new principal obtains saved credentials; existing no-navigate origin binding remains effective, and auth does not silently insert into a different focused field.
claim.attacker: Authorized-origin page JavaScript, unrelated origins, and selector text supplied by the local caller.
claim.scope: Replacement of PR1999 on exact final head; disposable local credentials only.

principals: Authorized page already able to read its own credential inputs
boundaries: Active no-navigate page to effective profile URL

prerequisites: Selected field replaced or focus redirected by page behavior

chain.capability: Page already controls DOM and reads intended input values.
chain.reachability: Original CLI race reproduced on Chrome and Lightpanda.
chain.control: Existing authorized origin, not a newly empowered principal.
chain.boundary: No new attacker authority is established by the original misdelivery.
chain.impact: The replacement prevents credential destination corruption and false successful submission.

evidence: Origin checks and profile/plugin resolution remain unchanged; all no-navigate origin/state E2E tests pass.
